component.name: Rotline
component.summary: Top-down zombie survival in three chapters and an endless mode

description.p: Rotline is a top-down zombie survival game made for Luma. The power's out, the neighbours aren't themselves, and the only way is through: hold out until morning, find fuel for the car, defend a generator, clear the subway and bring down the big ones. Play it with a keyboard and mouse, a touch screen, a TV remote or a gamepad.

ul.li: Twelve levels across three chapters: the suburbs at dusk, downtown at night in the rain, and the harbor in the fog
Real-time lights and shadows: your torch, street lamps, muzzle flashes and explosions, with every wall, car and crate casting a shadow
Five kinds of goal: survive, escape, defend, clear and bring down a boss
Six kinds of dead, from shuffling walkers to runners, spitters, bloaters, brutes and the Tank
Six weapons, from a pistol that never runs dry to a shotgun, an SMG and a rifle that goes through a crowd
A dodge roll, grenades, hordes and kill streaks
Endless mode: no way out and no end, and your longest run to beat
Upgrades bought with scrap you earn by playing: toughness, firepower, fire rate, speed and ammo
No mouse? It aims and fires for you, so a remote, a gamepad or one thumb is all you need
Story mode halves the damage you take, for anyone who'd rather see the story than fight it

description.p: Chapter 1, Endless and every upgrade are free, with no ads. Chapters 2 and 3, the Arsenal (flamethrower and crossbow) and the Survivors (four more characters to play as) are optional one-time purchases, paid through Stripe, with a Complete pack that has all four. Nothing is sold by the coin and nothing is random.

description.p: Fairer Tank fights: in Rooftop Signal and The Ferry the Tanks now come one at a time, a few seconds apart, they're a little less tough in later chapters, and the horde thins out while one is up. The Docks and The Ferry ease off slightly too, and every level of Chapters 2 and 3 is now checked by a bot before release.
On a computer whose processor is too old for the game engine (no SSE4.2), Rotline now says so instead of quietly not starting.

The first release, made with Godot 4.7: twelve levels in three chapters with real-time lights and shadows, Endless, six weapons, grenades and a dodge roll, six kinds of dead, upgrades, five survivors, Story mode, and play by keyboard and mouse, touch, TV remote or gamepad.
